title: PR body claims "The world pass draws NO text" but draw_world draws camera-scaled text (health '!' glyph) — scope 6's documented resolution is false
evidence: _pr_body_camera_zoom.md: "- **Text at zoom: snap to screen-space.** The world pass draws NO text; every label (QoS readouts, heat %, node chips) draws at fixed screen sizes via the bilinear-filtered font atlas, anchored to world positions through the live transform. There is no world-space text to scale, so no blurry bitmap scaling exists (rule 6 resolved by construction, documented)." — vs app/render/view.odin (draw_world -> draw_nodes:981 draw_health_ring -> ): 992: "	s := v.tile_px * v.scale" ; 1018: "	fs := i32(max(14, s * 0.5))" ; 1022: "	draw_text_c(v, glyph, x, y, fs, col)"
detail: Scope 6 says "pick and document"; the documented pick is false. draw_world draws '!'/'!!' at fs=max(14, s*0.5) where s=tile_px*v.scale — world text scaling with zoom (~14px at fit, ~40px at 4.0).
recommended_fix: Correct the PR-body rule-6 note: world text = the health glyph, which scales with the camera via the 64px bilinear atlas (or pin fs to a fixed screen size).

title: PR body claims trackpad "fractional deltas accumulate per frame and fire whole notches" — no accumulator exists; fractional deltas truncate to zero and never zoom
evidence: _pr_body_camera_zoom.md: "- **Wheel step is integer-notch** (1.25^n via repeated multiply, no libm — the §10.4 rule); smooth-trackpad fractional deltas accumulate per frame and fire whole notches (same truncation the old NOC scroll used)." — vs app/render/camera.odin: "camera_zoom_step :: proc(z, delta: f32) -> f32 { / \tf := f32(1) / \tfor d := i32(delta); d > 0; d -= 1 {" and app/input/poll.odin:79-81: "\tif w := rl.GetMouseWheelMove(); w != 0 { / \t\tappend(&inp.events, Device_Event(Mouse_Wheel{delta = w, pos = pos})) / \t}"
detail: The chain poll -> mouse_map -> Zoom intent -> on_zoom -> camera_zoom_step has no cross-frame accumulation; i32(delta) truncates each frame independently. Sub-1.0/frame trackpad deltas (typical macOS) silently never zoom — Mac is a launch target.
recommended_fix: Keep a residual fractional-notch accumulator in effect_zoom (fire whole notches on carry), and fix the PR-body claim to match.

title: touch.odin header still documents Pan as "a deliberate no-op in the executor today" — contradicts the executor this diff changed
evidence: app/input/touch.odin:9-10: "// Two fingers = the Pan intent (camera-pan — a deliberate no-op in the // executor today, see Pan; flagged in the PR per §18 OQ-1: landscape framing" — vs app/input/exec.odin case Pan: "\t\tif inp.on_pan != nil { / \t\t\tinp.on_pan(inp.user, inp, v.dx, v.dy) / \t\t}"
detail: The diff rewired the Pan executor (types.odin's twin comment was updated) but left touch.odin describing the retired no-op — a future reader gets the wrong contract.
recommended_fix: Update the touch.odin comment to mirror types.odin's "the 5.4 no-op is superseded" note.

title: NOC wheel hit-box excludes the drawn plate rim — wheel over the visible border zooms the map instead of scrolling the log
evidence: app/render/noc_overlay.odin:331-333: "noc_panel_hit :: proc(pos: rl.Vector2) -> bool { / \treturn pos.x >= NOC_PANEL_X && pos.x < NOC_PANEL_X + NOC_PANEL_W && / \t\tpos.y >= NOC_PANEL_Y && pos.y < NOC_PANEL_Y + NOC_PANEL_H" — vs the drawn plate, noc_overlay.odin:541: "\trl.DrawRectangle(NOC_PANEL_X - 8, NOC_PANEL_Y - 10, NOC_PANEL_W + 16, NOC_PANEL_H + 20, NOC_PLATE)"
detail: The plate renders 8/10px beyond the hit rect, so a wheel notch on that visible rim is neither log-scroll nor blocked — it zooms the map under the panel edge.
recommended_fix: Widen noc_panel_hit to the drawn plate rect (NOC_PANEL_X-8 .. +W+8, NOC_PANEL_Y-10 .. +H+10).
